agents.goal: Assess the candidate's legal knowledge and communication skills
agents.name: Interviewer

constraints: Answer questions without prior knowledge of the interviewer's questions
agents.goal: Demonstrate legal expertise and fit for the role
agents.name: Candidate

agents.goal: Accurately record the interview for later review
agents.name: Note-Taker

causes.hypothesis: Candidates with stronger legal knowledge will perform better in the interview
causes.name: Legal knowledge

causes.hypothesis: Candidates who communicate more clearly will be rated higher
causes.name: Communication clarity

causes.hypothesis: Higher confidence will lead to better performance
causes.name: Confidence level

interaction.stopping_rule: After the candidate answers all questions and the note-taker summarizes the interview

outcome.measurement_question: How would the interviewer rate the candidate's performance on a scale of 1 to 10?
outcome.name: Interview success
outcome.operationalization: The interviewer's assessment of the candidate's suitability for the role

scenario: A person is interviewing for a job as a lawyer
